specification.outcome: Normal conversation can create an ordinary Backlog task or replace an unclaimed Backlog task specification without requiring a campaign or starting work.

scenarios.name: atomically create an ordinary task
given: create-task has parsed title, description, and optional complete TaskSpecification
when: the host journals and publishes the request
then: one signed task-created-from-request event projects metadata and specification Option atomically
the task is unclaimed Backlog with no campaign provenance
the receipt returns task ID, event ID, board head, specification digest Option, and published disposition

scenarios.name: amend only a backlog specification
given: specify-task has an exact TaskId UUID and parsed replacement specification
when: the host publishes task-specified against its observed head and current digest Option
then: only specification and digest change
identity, metadata, lifecycle, claim, ordering, priority, and campaign provenance are preserved
no readiness, claim, run, campaign, or worktree effect occurs

scenarios.name: reject invalid lifecycle before effects
given: the amendment target is claimed, Ready, In Progress, or Done, or changes to one of those conditions during publication
when: the host evaluates or revalidates the request
then: TIBER_TASK_LIFECYCLE_INVALID is returned before signing or publication
no task field changes

scenarios.name: retry only unrelated concurrent advancement
given: a journaled operation binds stable operation, task, and event IDs plus request digest, board head, and expected specification Option
then: the host retries with unchanged IDs only when generated identities remain absent and target preconditions are unchanged
same-task identity, lifecycle, or specification changes return TIBER_TASK_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT and require new user evaluation
stale authority never overwrites newer authority

scenarios.name: reconcile identifiers and lost receipts
given: before intent the host tries at most three task/event UUID pairs, regenerating both when either collides
after intent publication may succeed without a recorded receipt
then: three colliding pairs return TIBER_TASK_ID_COLLISION
an exact operation ID, request digest, IDs, and canonical event reconcile once with reconciled disposition
any mismatch returns TIBER_TASK_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT and no duplicate event is published

scenarios.name: apply typed denial precedence
given: a create-task or specify-task request has multiple invalid facts
when: the host evaluates facts until the first denial
then: create precedence is TIBER_WORKFLOW_REQUEST_INVALID for malformed or partial shape, TIBER_SPECIFICATION_INVALID for complete-shape semantic failure, TIBER_TASK_BOARD_READ_ONLY, TIBER_TASK_ID_COLLISION, TIBER_TASK_PUBLICATION_UNAUTHORIZED, TIBER_TASK_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT

amend precedence is TIBER_WORKFLOW_REQUEST_INVALID, TIBER_TASK_ID_INVALID, TIBER_SPECIFICATION_INVALID, TIBER_TASK_BOARD_READ_ONLY, TIBER_TASK_NOT_FOUND, TIBER_TASK_LIFECYCLE_INVALID, TIBER_TASK_PUBLICATION_UNAUTHORIZED, TIBER_TASK_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT
no denied request has partial effects

scenarios.name: route independently of campaigns
given: the user asks to create a ticket or edit a Backlog specification
then: it requests create-task or specify-task rather than campaign-goal or begin-task
campaign state is neither required nor changed
an unchanged replacement digest returns TIBER_TASK_SPECIFICATION_UNCHANGED without publishing

acceptanceCriteria: task-created-from-request contains operation ID, request digest, metadata, and matching specification/digest Options and is projected atomically under ordinary signed ancestry verification.

Canonical create digest input is {kind,title,description,specification Option}; amend input is {kind,taskId,specification}. Digests are sha256 of JSON.stringify of parsed canonical values; conversation wording and generated IDs are excluded.
A host-generated operation ID distinguishes a repeated user request from recovery. The intent journals operation ID, digest, stable IDs, head, and expected specification Option before effects.
Omitted create specification means Option none; partial shape is TIBER_WORKFLOW_REQUEST_INVALID; complete but semantically invalid is TIBER_SPECIFICATION_INVALID.

Success receipts contain code, published|unchanged|reconciled disposition, taskId, full boardHead, eventId Option, and specificationDigest Option. Denials contain stable code and safe operation/task context.
Ordinary create and amend never promote, prioritize, review, claim, start, or alter campaign state.
exclusions: Changing title or description after creation
specification.architectureImplications: Add closed create-task and specify-task requests, one atomic task-created-from-request event, and durable operation intents/receipts. The host owns canonicalization, bounded IDs, lifecycle and expected-state checks, signing, retry classification, and reconciliation; inference grants no authority and cannot start work.
